text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Well, now that the race is done, time to 
start training for the next goal...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
"...I don't know why, but sorry for saying 
something like this—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
—It just feels kind of restrictive, you 
know? Even when I think I'm running all 
out...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, maybe I'm just a little tired. 
Well, it's fine. I'll just go to bed early 
tonight.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It might be because she's been busy with 
races lately. It looks like we'll need to 
review the schedule...
